newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Derailment shuts Senegal-Mali rail line.
newsitem.headline: Derailment shuts Senegal-Mali rail line.

text.p: The railway line linking Senegal and Mali was closed after a train accident in which 15 people were injured, railway officials said on Friday.
They said the train travelling from the Malian capital Bamako to Dakar went off the rails on Thursday near the Senegalese village of Dialakoto, 600 km (375 miles) from Dakar.
"Rail traffic between Bamako and Dakar is currently interrupted and passengers have been transferred to road transport for the journey to Dakar," an official told Reuters.
The cause of the accident has not been established.
